title: Configuration decoder
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $x$ be a Boolean input string. Given natural numbers $s$ and $c$, return a configuration of $N$ on input $x$ whose configuration code at window parameter $s$ is $c$ and which lies in the corresponding configuration window, if such a configuration exists; otherwise return no configuration.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the configuration-window predicate or the code's underlying encoding.
